title: code
description: Shared catalogs, routing, account choices, reviewed session composition and job-shaped session runs over the native OMP plugin.

atyrode.omp.reason: OMP owns destination readiness, workspace preparation, probing and reviewed session execution; Code's session doors call its own doors in process.

atyrode.omp.accounts.reason: OMP owns the shared account broker, usage observations and sign-in authority; Code's session doors read its observation in process.

atyrode.omp.gateway.reason: OMP owns the governed per-destination model gateway.
